reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) directly supports that Pd addition and annealing reduce exchange energy distribution, increase magnetic homogeneity, and yield ~40% RC enhancement in NiFeCoCrPdx, but the specific mechanistic link to lowered domain wall pinning and hysteresis is inferred rather than explicitly demonstrated in the cited passages.
premises: Pd addition and annealing reduce the distribution of exchange energies in NiFeCoCr-based HEAs
Reduced exchange energy distribution increases magnetic homogeneity
Increased magnetic homogeneity enhances refrigerant capacity (RC) by ~40%
The enhancement is linked to a more homogeneous magnetic matrix with fewer defects/minor phases
These changes lower hysteresis and domain wall pinning, improving low-field magnetocaloric response
